name: Zechariah
title: John's father
summary: Zechariah was a priest of the division of Abijah, married to Elizabeth. After many years without children, he received an angel's message that he would have a son - John the Baptist. Because he doubted, he was made mute until John was born. His song of praise, the Benedictus, is one of the Bible's most beautiful hymns.

keyEvents.title: Service in the temple
keyEvents.description: Zechariah was chosen to offer incense in the temple, a great honor for a priest.

keyEvents.title: The angel's message
keyEvents.description: The angel Gabriel appeared and announced that Zechariah would have a son.

keyEvents.title: Muteness
keyEvents.description: Because Zechariah doubted the angel's words, he was made mute until the promise was fulfilled.

keyEvents.title: Naming of John
keyEvents.description: At the circumcision, Zechariah wrote that the child should be named John, and his speech was restored.

keyEvents.title: Benedictus - The Song of Praise
keyEvents.description: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Zechariah sang his prophetic song of praise about salvation.
